channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Mark Amodei explains his surprise decision to retire from Congress this year
item.description: Amodei said concerns about Republicans losing the House in 2026 did not shape his decision. He is the latest of nearly three dozen House members to hang up their hats ahead of the midterms.

item.title: With ICE using Medicaid data, hospitals in a bind over warning immigrant patients
item.description: Warning patients could deter them from signing up for a program called Emergency Medicaid, through which the government reimburses hospitals for the cost of emergency treatment for immigrants who are ineligible for standard Medicaid coverage.

item.title: Nevada’s legal cannabis sales fell nearly 9 percent in 2025. Is tourism slump to blame?
item.description: The decrease caused a dip in the cannabis industry’s contribution to the State Education Fund. Regulators also plan to look at the state’s tax structure.

item.title: Caso de electores falsos de Nevada retoma debate sobre lo que motivó ceremonia pro-Trump en 2020
item.description: La juez del Condado Clark, Mary Kay Holthus, se mostró escéptica ante los argumentos de la fiscalía sobre el cargo de "ofrecer un instrumento falso" porque requiere una "intención de defraudar".

item.title: Lombardo’s 2025 campaign fundraising heavily reliant on donors using legal loophole to give more
item.description: About $1.9 million of Lombardo’s fundraising total came from donors who easily and legally skirted contribution limits by sending donations through different names. This made up about 44 percent of his campaign's haul

item.title: Once rare in Nevada, winter bald eagle sightings now common
item.description: Bald eagles are one of the rarest nesting raptors in the state, but they flock to the state for winter feeding. An annual winter count in Tahoe monitors those numbers, reflecting broader state and national populations.

item.title: OPINION: America’s runaway sports betting obsession ensures that ‘Everybody Loses’
item.description: It’s a story that includes strict sports gambling prohibitionists who later give thumbs-up to a league’s full embrace of the betting bonanza.

item.title: Pro-Lombardo PAC launches major ad campaign against top Democratic contender Aaron Ford
item.description: The seven-figure spending underscores Republicans’ belief that Ford’s time spent out of state is a vulnerability.

item.title: Will Nevada students face consequences for protesting ICE?
item.description: Many Nevada students have walked out of class in response to the Trump administration’s immigration enforcement operations.

item.title: Antes escasos en Nevada, avistamientos de águilas calvas en invierno ahora son comunes
item.description: Las águilas calvas son una de las aves rapaces anidadoras más raras de Nevada, pero acuden en bandadas para alimentarse durante el invierno. Un conteo anual de esta temporada en Tahoe refleja poblaciones estatales y nacionales más grandes.
